question: Which of the given personalities is NOT associated with Carnatic Music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishnu Narayan Bhatkhande.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vishnu Narayan Bhatkhande **is** not associated** with Carnatic Music.

 
 
• He was a Hindustani classical **music composer, theorist, and musicologist.**
 
 
 
• **Kalyani Varadarajan **is associated with **Carnatic Music**.
 
 
• She is a renowned **Carnatic vocalist and composer.**
 
 
 
• **MS Subbulakshmi **is associated with **Carnatic Music.**
 
 
• She was a legendary Carnatic **vocalist and musician.**
 
 
 
• **Subramania Bharathiyar** is associated with **Carnatic Music**.
 
 
• He was a** Tamil poet, writer, and independence activist** who composed songs in Tamil that are popularly sung in Carnatic Music concerts. 
 
 
 
• Carnatic Music is a form of **classical music **that originated in **South India.**
 
• It is characterized by **intricate rhythms, melodic improvisation**, and a rich repertoire of compositions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kalyani Varadarajan** is a disciple of the legendary **Carnatic musician, Semmangudi Srinivasa Iyer.**

 
 
• She has won **several awards and accolades **for her contributions to Carnatic Music.
 
 
 
• **MS Subbulakshmi** was the **first musician** to be awarded the **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award.
 
 
• She was also the** first Indian musician **to perform at the **United Nations General Assembly.**
 
 
 
• **Subramania Bharathiyar's** compositions are known for their **patriotic fervor and social messages**. \
 
 
• They are popularly sung in** Carnatic Music concerts** as well as other forms of music.
 
 
 
• **Vishnu Narayan Bhatkhande** is known for his contribution to** Hindustani classical music**.
 
 
• He is credited with organizing and codifying the existing forms of** Hindustani classical music i**nto a systematic and scientific framework.
